changelog: TestRunner: external CI / scripts can drive UnityAgent via MCP. CaptureMeshIsolated: capture a single mesh from multiple angles in scene-wide isolation. Group A capture tools (CaptureSceneView, CaptureMultiAngle, CaptureFacePreview, ScanAvatarMeshes) gain unified quality params (maxWidth, format, jpgQuality, saveToPath). Default resolution bumped to 1024. Various bounds calculation and isolation fixes. CaptureExpressionPreview unified with CaptureFacePreview (no SceneView side effects).
